title: Renormalization through Langmann–Szabo Duality
exact_target: Use position--momentum duality to construct and understand renormalizable noncommutative quantum field models.

status_qualification: The original report already describes the successful harmonic scalar construction. Its broad construction question is historical and model dependent; it must not be converted into a claim that no example is known, or into an unsupported theorem for all noncommutative field theories.
